functions.name: register
functions.description: Adds the Notes column to the message list.

functions.name: setTexts
functions.description: Sets the column text for each Message-ID, then redraws the column.

parameters.description: Map of Message-ID (no angle brackets) to the cell text.

parameters.name: laterTexts
parameters.description: Map of Message-ID to the cell texts of the later messages that reference it.
